services.name: On View Exhibits
services.desc: Please note: Due to an A/C outage in the back mezzanine galleries and Education Center, the Museum is not currently climate controlled. Learn more > The New York Transit Museum is dedicated to collecting, preserving and making accessible materials relating to the region’s land based public transportation systems, past and present. Explore our selection of digital exhibits. For 50 years, the New York Transit Museum has preserved and shared the stories of the system that moves millions every day. Trace the journey of our Court Street station home, our collection of over 1 million image and artifacts, and our community, from construction in the 1930s to the living, breathing museum it is

services.name: Public Programs
services.desc: Please note: Due to an A/C outage in the back mezzanine galleries and Education Center, the Museum is not currently climate controlled. Learn more > The New York Transit Museum hosts programs at its space in Downtown Brooklyn, online, and all over the city, bringing New York City and transit history to life. Dive into transit past and present, explore neighborhoods and landmarks, encounter art and culture, and have once-in-a-lifetime experiences. To stay up to date and be the first to register for upcoming events, sign up for our newsletter and explore our program calendar. Throughout the year, the New York Transit Museum offers special opportunities to ride our beloved vintage trains

services.name: Camp
services.desc: School’s out, adventure’s in! At this action-packed day camp inside our historic subway station museum, campers explore the world of transportation through hands-on activities like artmaking, engineering challenges, scavenger hunts, and science experiments. With small group sizes, each camper gets personalized support
